claim.statement: Google's current Jules FAQ says each task runs in a fresh virtual machine where Jules clones the repository, installs dependencies and makes prompt-directed changes.

source.title: Jules FAQ
source.locator: How does Jules work under the hood?

limitations: The word fresh is a publisher description; the catalog did not inspect VM creation, teardown, reuse or isolation.
Repository cloning, dependency installation and changes were not observed.
unknowns: The VM image digest, region, tenancy, hardware, retention, isolation and teardown behavior are unknown.
The credentials, repository permissions and subprocess authority available inside a real task are unknown.
